statement: This sketch creates a dynamic simulation of iron filings responding to magnetic forces. These trails gradually disperse over time, maintaining an ephemeral quality where the composition is perpetually shifting and evolving. The visual effect captures the delicate balance between natural settling and external influence, rendering a quiet yet dynamic field of simulated metallic particles.
